FAQ

What are your opening hours?

We're open Monday to Friday, 10am to 6pm, and on Saturdays from 10am to 2pm. On concert or event nights we may stay open later. Check the agenda for details.

Do you serve food?

Yes! Our kitchen prepares homemade tapas from family recipes and seasonal produce, perfect for sharing over a craft beer.

Can I book a table?

Of course. Give us a call or send us an email to entrelinhascafebistro@gmail.com with the date, time and number of people. On concert nights we recommend booking in advance.

Can I bring children?

Of course! Children are welcome when accompanied by an adult. Entrelinhas is a meeting place for all generations.

I have a band and would love to play at your place. How can I do that?

We love discovering new musicians! Send us an email at entrelinhascafebistro@gmail.com with the following:
- A short text introducing your band and your musical style (in Portuguese and English)
- Links, if you have them, so we can listen to your work (YouTube, Spotify, Instagram...)
- A single YouTube video link (only if you have one, of course)
- 2 photos: one HORIZONTAL and one VERTICAL

Can I book the venue for a private party?

Yes, we host birthdays, group dinners and other celebrations. Get in touch by phone or email with the date, number of guests and what you have in mind, and we'll put together a tailored proposal.
